During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Sepan campaign]], a combined [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] '''attacked''' the Imperial [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' as it delivered a shipment of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']]. The attackers were defeated by the Imperial forces.

==Prelude==
The [[Dimok government|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus government]]s had been [[Sepan Civil War|at war]] with each other, but once the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] arrived and [[Sepan campaign|intervened]] in order to bring the two sides to an agreement, they instead decided to team up against a common enemy. After a series of defeats, the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] attempted a large offensive against a [[TIE/ad starfighter]] convoy that was supplying them to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], in order to replace the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] that were lost throughout the Imperial campaign.

==The battle==
As the TIE/ad starfighters flew from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' to the [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']], the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] of Admiral Harkov, Dimok forces launched an assault starting with a [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] called [[Ben Het]] exiting hyper space and launched several [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] followed by [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified Corvette]] [[Long Tan]] finally followed by two [[Cargo ferry|Cargo ferries]] [[Suoi Tre]] and [[Can Giouc]]. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], an elite [[TIE pilot]], engaged the Dimok forces with several other TIE/LN starfighters and interceptors. They fought the attacking fighters to give time for the TIE/ad starfighters to make it aboard the ''Protector''. After defeating the enemy fighters and defending the TIE/ad flights [[Group AA|AA]], [[Group AB|AB]], [[Group AC|AC]], and [[Group AD|AD]], the Imperial pilots engaged the Ben Het as well as the Long Tan, Suoi Tre and Can Giouc, holding of the attacking starships until they were either driven off or destroyed. Soon afterwards the Ripoblus joined the battle with [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] [[Shemsher]] with two groups of [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]], [[Raven (Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle)|Raven]] and [[Seakyte]]. The Ripoblus faced similar results as their escort shuttles were destroyed and the Frigate was driven off, if not destroyed.

==Aftermath==
After the fighting, a shuttle called ''[[Omlaut]]'' arrived to board the ''Protector''. Stele inspected it to find the shuttle carrying a high-ranking member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The shuttle boarded the ''Protector'' and, according to a member of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret order of the Empire]], the individual was taken directly to Harkov and they have been alone ever since. Combined with the chronic shortages of weapons and equipment reported by Harkov, this implied that he was selling Imperial weapons and supplies to whoever had the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

Resupplied with new starfighters, Admiral Harkov forced the leaders of the two warring factions to meet him aboard his vessel and make peace agreements, ending the campaign and ending a decades-long civil war. Elite pilot Stele was sent to the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] afterwards.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle takes place in the game Star Wars: TIE Fighter. It is on Battle 2 Mission 5.

The canonicity of the mission is debatable as the bonus objectives of the mission in question is the destruction of all enemy spacecraft of both the Dimoks and the Ripoblus. This is extremely difficult as the player pilots a TIE Fighter and likely has to rely on TIE Bombers to help destroy the capital ships in the mission.
